page_title: Invompt. Your AI knows the work. Invoice it.

sources.entry: Invompt - Turns work from Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor into invoices, quotes, and estimates you review before sending, through the hosted MCP at https://mcp.invompt.com/mcp. You can try it as a guest, with no account. #free

summary.name: Invompt
summary.one_liner: Invompt turns work discussed in an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) into invoice, quote, or estimate drafts that the user reviews before sending.
use_cases: Turn a conversation with an AI into a client invoice
Draft quotes or estimates from scoped work
Review and revise invoice details before sending
Invoice clients for AI-assisted or AI-first work
Try invoicing without creating an account
summary.what_it_does: Invompt connects to AI apps such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor through a hosted MCP endpoint. It reads the work already discussed in the conversation, such as scoped items with quantities and rates, and builds a structured invoice draft. The user can check the details and request changes in the same conversation before deciding the invoice is ready. A demo shows a fictional invoice for Northstar Labs with subtotal and total calculated. Saved clients, company details, and invoice history require creating an account. Accounting and payment integrations (Xero, QuickBooks, Stripe, Sage) are listed as coming next, not currently available.
notable: Hosted MCP server at mcp.invompt.com for use inside AI assistants
Drafts are reviewed by the user before anything is created or sent
Guest use with no sign-up or credit card required
Accounting and payment integrations (Xero, QuickBooks, Stripe, Sage) on roadmap
caveats: Saved clients, company details, and invoice history require an account
Accounting and payment tool integrations are roadmap items, not yet available
The on-page invoice example is fictional and creates or sends nothing
